properties.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 14 at 2:48PM MDT until October 15 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Thursday morning low temperatures in the mid 20s to lower
30s.

* WHERE...The San Luis Valley.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 8 AM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Freezing temperatures could kill crops, other sensitive
vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...This could be a killing freeze which could
bring an end to the growing season across the San Luis Valley.
properties.areaDesc: Del Norte Vicinity/Northern San Luis Valley Below 8500 Ft; Alamosa  Vicinity/Central San Luis Valley Below 8500 Ft; Southern San Luis Valley

properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 14 at 2:48PM MDT until October 16 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures in the upper 20 to lower 30s
possible.

* WHERE...El Paso and Kiowa counties.

* WHEN...From late Thursday night through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The coldest readings are most likely to occur
across northern El Paso county.
properties.areaDesc: Northern El Paso County/Monument Ridge/Rampart Range Below 7500 Ft; Colorado Springs Vicinity/Southern El Paso County/Rampart Range Below 7400 Ft; Western Kiowa County; Eastern Kiowa County

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 14 at 1:41PM MDT until October 15 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 12
inches.

* WHERE...Rabbit Ears Pass, Rocky Mountain National Park and the
Medicine Bow Range, and The Mountains of Summit County, the
Mosquito Range, and the Indian Peaks.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Snow covered roads will make travel hazardous, especially
through mountain passes. Use caution when traveling.
